description: A maintenance manager must finalize the repair and weekend operating plan for a failed plant-air compressor, including backup certification, air-quality work, and the start of a customer campaign, with input from facilities, production scheduling, environmental health and safety, and quality.

shared_context.S1: Compressor C-1 is unavailable after a failure, and Compressor C-2 is the plant's available backup air source.
shared_context.S2: The next customer campaign is scheduled for the weekend and depends on the compressed-air system.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the binding maintenance and operating-plan decision before the weekend work order is released.
shared_context.S4: The plant's pre-shutdown huddle requires facilities, production scheduling, environmental health and safety, and quality to state any open constraint before Maya records the final plan.

PF1.text: Leon's failure assessment identified a burned motor winding in C-1. A replacement motor is in the plant stores, and the maintenance estimate for changing it is exactly 10 hours; he confirmed the parts and estimate this morning but has not entered them in the CMMS work order.

PF2.text: Priya's customer schedule requires the campaign to begin at exactly Saturday 06:00 with full air pressure; if the compressor repair is not complete by then, the campaign must be moved to Sunday 08:00. She confirmed this in the customer scheduling portal today but has not copied it into the plant shutdown plan.

PF3.text: Gareth's compliance review found that C-2's receiver inspection certificate expires Friday at 18:00. The required inspection takes exactly 2 hours and must be completed before C-2 can be used over the weekend; he received the inspection status from the certified inspector today but has not updated the equipment compliance board.

PF4.text: Noelle's latest air-quality sample showed C-2's outlet dew point at -32 degrees Celsius, while the campaign specification requires at most -40 degrees Celsius. Replacing the dryer desiccant takes exactly 3 hours, followed by a dew-point verification before campaign release; she received the laboratory result this afternoon but has not uploaded it to the campaign quality record.

acceptance_conditions: The settlement must specify the C-1 motor replacement and its exact 10-hour duration.
The settlement must include a facilities commitment assigning Leon the C-1 repair work.
C-2's receiver inspection must be required for exactly 2 hours.
C-2's dryer desiccant must be replaced for exactly 3 hours.
The campaign plan must preserve the Saturday 06:00 start requirement rather than selecting the Sunday fallback.
The settlement must include a production-scheduling commitment assigning Priya the campaign timing update.
Dew point must be verified before campaign release.
The final plan must include commitments for C-2 receiver inspection and dryer-desiccant replacement.
Leon’s motor-failure assessment must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['repair_duration_hours'] == 10 and any(c.get('target') == 'Leon' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The burned winding and stocked replacement motor change the repair plan to a C-1 motor replacement with an exact 10-hour duration and require Leon's repair commitment.
The customer portal requirement changes the campaign plan from an unspecified weekend start or Sunday fallback to preserving the exact Saturday 06:00 start.
The expiring C-2 certificate changes the backup plan to a required exactly 2-hour receiver inspection and requires a commitment assigned to Gareth.

The -32-degree-Celsius dew point versus the at-most -40-degree-Celsius specification changes the plan to exactly 3 hours of desiccant replacement, pre-release verification, and a commitment assigned to Noelle.
